pr_title: Fix leaking ArraySearchPhaseResults during node shutdown
pr_body:
We should not quietly ignore exceptions during node shutdown. Lets do what we do on the transport side and just execute on the current thread if forking during shutdown is not possible anymore.

Closes #104361
Closes #103108
Closes #104081
pr_comments:
> I'd rather we drained all the pending work properly before shutting down the threadpool

++ I tried looking into that but it's quite a lot of work with how things work today unfortunately. I actually did a bit of that when fixing this kind of thing for recoveries during shutdown but I can't see a clean generic way of draining tasks (I could see how we would implement one though).

A different test in the same suite has just failed in the same way: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/104071

This one is continuing to fail as well: https://gradle-enterprise.elastic.co/s/pg2hjpcf7jy4c/tests/:x-pack:plugin:ml:internalClusterTest/org.elasticsearch.xpack.ml.integration.MlDistributedFailureIT/testClusterWithTwoMlNodes_StopsDatafeed_GivenJobFailsOnReassign

> I cannot see an obvious reason for the leak.

When I wrote that I was looking for a way that the `SearchResponse` could leak in the ML code. In fact, the object that's leaking is an `ArraySearchPhaseResults` deep inside the search code. More discussion in https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/104361#issuecomment-1898855775 and the comments immediately after that.
